moat_against: Keysight is larger, broader and better resourced in every overlapping category
Consolidated ROIC ~8% in FY24-26, at the cost of capital, per fundamentals.json roic_proxy
Gross margin flat at ~57-60% for ten years — no demonstrated pricing power
Cyclical capex end demand: revenue fell from $1,292M (FY22) to $1,000M (FY24) before the AI snap-back
SBC runs 49-59% of operating cash flow (FY25-26), a persistent transfer to employees
Growth partly bought (Spirent, Inertial Labs) with amortization and restructuring charges attached
moat_for: #2 share in network test & measurement (14-16%) in a concentrated oligopoly with high R&D/IP barriers
Spirent deal gives a 40-45% high-share position in AI data-center Ethernet validation
OSP niche: anti-counterfeiting and 3D sensing at 55.2% gross margin and 40% operating margin (Q4 FY26)
Tools embedded in carrier and hyperscaler lab/field workflows, with calibration and service attach
moat_justification: Real #2 position in network test (14-16% share vs Keysight 18-20%) plus a strong OSP niche (3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting at 55% gross / 40% operating margin) and a 40-45% share in AI data-center Ethernet validation via Spirent — but consolidated ROIC was only ~8% in FY24-26 (at the cost of capital) and gross margin has been flat at ~57-60% for a decade, so no demonstrated pricing power or durable wide moat.
name: Viavi Solutions Inc.
one_liner: Real AI data-center test franchise, moat 4/10 — but owner's earnings are $0.12/share against a $33.38 price (weighted IRR at most ~3.0%, IV@15% $1.18); clears 15% only below ~$1.18.
